newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Reliance gains before bonus meet.
newsitem.headline: India's Reliance gains before bonus meet.

text.p: India's leading private sector company, Reliance Industries Ltd, was up 5.50 rupees, or 1.50 percent, at 372 ahead of a board meeting to announce a bonus share issue, traders said.
At 12.15 p.m. (0645 GMT), over 4.28 million shares of Reliance had changed hands on the Bombay Stock Exchange.
On the National Stock Exchange the stock was up 3.15 rupees at 371.70 with 11 million shares being traded.

Reliance chairman Dhirubhai Ambani told shareholders early on Thursday that the board would meet to finalise a bonus equity issue shortly after the firm's annual general meeting which began at 1100 a.m. (0530 GMT).
Traders have said they expected the company to announce a bonus ratio of three shares for every five shares held -- the same ratio as the firm's last two bonus issues in the 1980s.
But, some traders were hopeful that the firm could surprise the market by announcing a liberal bonus in the ratio of one share for every one held.
